gcb.source: Friedlingstein et al., Global Carbon Budget 2025, ESSD 18, 3211-3288 (2026), abstract, executive summary, Sections 3.2.2 and 3.9
gcb.values_status: Rounded source averages; removal values stored as positive magnitudes; shifting-cultivation quantities derived by subtraction, without inferred error bounds
gcb.cumulative_sign: Positive: sources exceed estimated atmospheric accumulation plus sinks
gcb.uncertainty_note: No uncertainty on the net discrepancy is inferred by summing marginal values; no country aggregate is equated to a biome mask
